D023_m001.question:
I’ve been struggling with my relationship with food for about a year and a half now—maybe longer, if I’m honest. It started during a particularly rough caseload at work; I was carrying a lot, managing clients in crisis, and honestly, I didn’t have much time to eat during the day. But then, in the evenings, I’d find myself suddenly ravenous, even if I’d eaten earlier. I’d open the cabinets or go to the grocery store late at night and end up eating entire packages of cookies, frozen meals, or whatever was quick and easy—things like whole loaves of bread, ice cream straight from the tub.  

What scares me is how out of control it feels. I’m not hungry anymore, but I can’t stop. I’ll eat until my stomach hurts, until I feel sick, and I almost always do it alone. I’ve started avoiding social dinners or making excuses not to go out—because if people saw how much I eat, I’d be so ashamed. I used to love potlucks, but now I dread them.  

It happens at least once a week, sometimes more. I tell myself I’ll stop, but when the urge hits, it’s like a switch flips. I feel overwhelmed, disconnected, and the only thing that numbs it is eating.
D023_m001.options:
A. Bulimia Nervosa
    B. Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)
    C. Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type)
    D. Binge-Eating Disorder

D023_m002.question:

I’ll clear out anything in the apartment: chips, frozen meals, cookies, whatever’s there. I keep telling myself I’ll stop after a snack, but I don’t. I keep going until I feel physically sick, bloated, like I can’t move. That fullness is awful, but I still can’t stop until it’s all gone.

The worst part is I’ll plan these binges. I’ll buy food knowing I’m not going to eat it all at once—but I do. And I always do it alone. I’d be way too embarrassed if someone saw me. I don’t want people thinking I’m out of control. It happens at least once a week, sometimes more. I can’t keep living like this.
D023_m002.options:
A. Bulimia Nervosa
    B. Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)
    C. Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type)
    D. Binge-Eating Disorder
